# Rooted Data

A independent data consultancy building transparent, reproducible data systems and actionable geospatial analytics for public health and urban environments.
:::

## Focus Areas

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
### Data Systems & Governance
Building data infrastructure designed for clarity and automated standards.

* **Strategy & Infrastructure:** Systems architecture focused on long-term sustainability.
* **Transparency & Reproducibility:** Clean, verifiable pipelines readable by both internal teams and external stakeholders.
* **Automated Standards:** Enforceable standards and protocols that maintain quality without manual overhead.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
### Spatial Science & Public Health
Applying spatial analysis and custom tooling to complex civic and health challenges.

* **Geospatial Data Science:** Custom spatial workflows, models, and data pipelines.
* **Urban Analytics:** Data driven insights tailored for municipal and community applications.
* **Community Engagement:** Tooling and visualizations that communicate complex data to public audiences.
:::
